lead.claim: Low-level laser therapy cuts carpal tunnel pain and boosts grip strength.
lead.context: *Why this matters*: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs found low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain and improved grip strength in carpal tunnel syndrome.

supporting.claim: VR cycling and traditional cycling are feasible for knee osteoarthritis.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: A feasibility RCT found that both VR-enhanced cycling and traditional cycling for 6 weeks were highly feasible and acceptable for people with knee osteoarthritis.

supporting.claim: Can a gamified robot help chronic stroke patients in the community?
supporting.context: A longitudinal study assessed user experience with RehabCARES, a gamified robot system for motor and cognitive rehabilitation in chronic stroke patients.

supporting.claim: Can XR games help with phantom limb pain, function, and prosthesis use?
supporting.context: A systematic review explored the preliminary benefits of XR serious games for reducing phantom limb pain, improving functional mobility, and supporting prosthesis adoption after amputation.

supporting.claim: What barriers prevent children from starting rehabilitation services?
supporting.context: This mixed-methods study investigated factors linked to the initiation of pediatric rehabilitation services, including sociodemographic characteristics and parental experiences.
